archetypes.name: dyn-model-routing
archetypes.rationale: Model selection now flows through defaults, tiers, roles, and environment overrides.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed launcher, waterfall, panel, voter, and Step 2 dispatch paths. Check that env overrides still win, blank defaults are never forwarded, and tier-specific Codex models match the policy matrix. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
